scenes.narration: Watch a tiny search find its pair in a single pass through the list, line by line.

scenes.title: Finding a pair in one pass

steps.narration: The function takes a list of numbers and a target total, and it promises to find a matching pair.
Now the loop walks through the list one number at a time, giving each of them a turn.
Here is the heart of the trick: it checks whether that needed partner has been seen before.
Otherwise the current number joins the seen set, and the loop simply moves to the next one.
If the whole list is finished with no partner found, the function honestly returns None.
Each number is checked exactly once, so the effort grows in step with the list size.
The seen set remembers past numbers, trading a little memory for instant lookups.
